reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Activity under preparation Initiative to promote and support private sector engagement and dialogue

description.narrative: The action proposes to support the engagement of private sector actors in Asia and Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) over a three-year period around the Commission¿s economic and political priorities and Global Gateway flagships. The five-year programme, the EU Africa Union Business Forum Facility provides similar support in the Africa continent. The Action comprises technical advice to the EU Delegations in the organization of business events, including EU Business fora and missions, with public and private stakeholders, from Europe and partner countries, the provision of market intelligence and the strengthening of service delivery capacities and competences of stakeholders, such as Trade Promotion Organizations (TPOs), Business Support Organizations (BSOs) and Export Credit Agencies (ECAs).   The business events are strategic occasions for the EU and partner countries to identify and/or consolidate joint opportunities in the spirit of Global Gateway for sustainable investment and jobs. The events organised by EU Delegations showcase key initiatives and promote interaction with business leaders. They are also an opportunity for business representatives to discuss policy reforms with policy makers (B2G) to improve the trade and investment environment and a platform for business-to-business (B2B) interaction between EU and national business. As a result, the Action contributes to achieve the Sustainable Development Goal 8 of Decent Work and Economic Growth.The events are also occasions to bring together private sector and European Development Finance Institutions to finance deals with support from EU financial instruments, including the European Fund for Sustainable Development Plus (EFSD+) guarantees.
